# Map of all hydrophone deployments
*Click a site for devices, deployment dates, and status. Deployed sites are shown; use the toggle to reveal inactive sites.*


```{python}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

import os, sys, pandas as pd
from onc.onc import ONC
from dotenv import load_dotenv
import geopandas as gpd
import json
from collections import defaultdict

sys.path.insert(0, "../scripts")
from hydrophone_status import annotate_deployments

# Load ONC cable shapefile
onc_cable_shp_path = '../Instrument_and_cables_shapefiles/ONC_Cables.shp'
onc_cable = gpd.read_file(onc_cable_shp_path)
onc_cable = onc_cable.to_crs("EPSG:4326")

load_dotenv()
onc = ONC(os.getenv("ONC_API_TOKEN"))

# 1. Fetch Deployments
depl = pd.DataFrame(onc.getDeployments({"deviceCategoryCode": "HYDROPHONE"}))

# 2. Prepare Location Names
names_df = pd.read_csv('../notebooks/location_names.txt', 
                       header=None, names=['locationCode','locationName'])

# 3. Merge Names into the main deployment dataframe first
depl = depl.merge(names_df, on='locationCode', how='left')
depl['locationName'] = depl['locationName'].fillna(depl['locationCode'])
depl['siteCode'] = depl['locationCode'].str.split('.').str[0]

def _blank(value):
    return value is None or pd.isna(value)

records = []
for row in depl.to_dict(orient="records"):
    records.append({
        **row,
        "begin": None if _blank(row.get("begin")) else row.get("begin"),
        "end": None if _blank(row.get("end")) else row.get("end"),
    })

devices = onc.getDevices({"deviceCategoryCode": "HYDROPHONE"})
devices_by_code = {item["deviceCode"]: item for item in devices}
annotated_rows = annotate_deployments(records, devices_by_code)

def _num(value):
    if _blank(value):
        return None
    return float(value)

rank = {"green": 0, "yellow": 1, "red": 2}
grouped = defaultdict(list)
for row in annotated_rows:
    grouped[row["siteCode"]].append(row)

sites = []
for site_code, group in grouped.items():
    group = sorted(group, key=lambda item: item.get("begin") or "")
    active = [item for item in group if not item.get("end")]
    current = active[-1] if active else group[-1]
    if active:
        status = max((item["status"] for item in active), key=lambda item: rank.get(item, 0))
    else:
        status = "inactive"
    sites.append({
        "siteCode": site_code,
        "locationName": current.get("locationName") or site_code,
        "lat": _num(current.get("lat")),
        "lon": _num(current.get("lon")),
        "depth": _num(current.get("depth")),
        "any_active": bool(active),
        "status": status,
        "deployments": [
            {
                "device": item["deviceCode"],
                "location": item["locationCode"],
                "begin": item.get("begin"),
                "end": item.get("end"),
                "status": item["status"],
                "url": item["annotationUrl"] if not item.get("end") else "",
                "notes": [
                    {"level": note["level"], "label": note["label"], "start": note["start"]}
                    for note in item["notes"]
                ],
            }
            for item in group
        ],
    })

cable_geojson = json.loads(onc_cable.to_json())

ojs_define(
    sites = sites,
    cable_data = cable_geojson
)
```


```{ojs}
//| echo: false

L = require("leaflet@1.9.4")
html`<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">`

container = html`<div style="height: 600px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #ddd;"></div>`
yield container;

{
  const map = L.map(container).setView([58, -95], 3);

  L.tileLayer('https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Ocean/World_Ocean_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', {
    attribution: 'Esri & Sources',
    maxZoom: 13
  }).addTo(map);

  const inactiveLayer = L.layerGroup();
  const activeLayer = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);

  if (cable_data) {
    L.geoJSON(cable_data, {
      style: {
        color: 'grey',
        weight: 1,
        opacity: 0.7
      }
    }).addTo(map);
  }

  const statusColor = {
    red: "#dc3545",
    yellow: "#ffc107",
    green: "#28a745",
    inactive: "#6c757d"
  };

  function esc(value) {
    return String(value ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (ch) {
      return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", "\"": "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[ch];
    });
  }

  function uniqueNotes(notes) {
    const seen = {};
    const out = [];
    (notes || []).forEach(function (note) {
      if (!note.label || seen[note.label]) return;
      seen[note.label] = true;
      out.push(note);
    });
    return out;
  }

  function notesInTimeOrder(notes) {
    const sorted = (notes || []).slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      return (b.start || "").localeCompare(a.start || "");
    });
    return uniqueNotes(sorted);
  }

  function noteHtml(note) {
    const level = note.level === "red" ? "red" : note.level === "green" ? "green" : "yellow";
    const since = note.start ? ` <span class="hydro-note-since">(since ${esc(note.start)})</span>` : "";
    return `<li class="hydro-note hydro-note-${level}"><span class="hydro-note-dot"></span><span class="hydro-note-text"><strong>${esc(note.label)}</strong>${since}</span></li>`;
  }

  function timelineHtml(notes, emptyGreen) {
    const items = notesInTimeOrder(notes);
    if (!items.length) {
      return emptyGreen ? `<ol class="hydro-timeline">${noteHtml({ level: "green", label: "No issues to report" })}</ol>` : "";
    }
    return `<ol class="hydro-timeline">${items.map(noteHtml).join("")}</ol>`;
  }

  function deviceCard(label, begin, url, notes) {
    const deployed = begin ? `<span class="hydro-deployed">deployed ${esc(begin)}</span>` : "";
    const link = url ? `<a href="${esc(url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">see more</a>` : "";
    const dot = deployed && link ? `<span class="hydro-meta-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>` : "";
    const meta = (deployed || link) ? `<span class="hydro-deployment-dates">${deployed}${dot}${link}</span>` : "";
    return `<div class="hydro-card"><div class="hydro-card-id"><strong>${esc(label)}</strong>${meta}</div>${timelineHtml(notes, true)}</div>`;
  }

  function currentBlock(rows) {
    if (!rows.length) {
      return `<p class="hydro-popup-heading hydro-popup-previous">No current deployments</p>`;
    }
    const count = rows.length > 1 ? ` (${rows.length})` : "";
    const cards = rows.map(function (row) {
      return deviceCard(row.device, row.begin, row.url, row.notes);
    }).join("");
    return `<p class="hydro-popup-heading hydro-popup-current">Current deployments${count}</p>${cards}`;
  }

  function previousBlock(rows) {
    if (!rows.length) return "";
    const body = rows.map(function (row) {
      return `<tr><td>${esc(row.device)}</td><td>${esc(row.begin || "—")}</td><td>${esc(row.end || "—")}</td></tr>`;
    }).join("");
    return `<p class="hydro-popup-heading hydro-popup-previous">Previous deployments</p><table class="hydro-popup-table"><tr><th>Device</th><th>From</th><th>To</th></tr>${body}</table>`;
  }

  sites.forEach(function (site) {
    if (site.lat == null || site.lon == null || Number.isNaN(Number(site.lat)) || Number.isNaN(Number(site.lon))) return;
    const isActive = site.any_active;
    const color = isActive ? (statusColor[site.status] || statusColor.green) : statusColor.inactive;
    const cleanName = String(site.locationName || site.siteCode).replace(/Hydrophone [A-Z]/g, "Hydrophone Array");
    const deployments = site.deployments || [];
    const activeRows = deployments.filter(function (row) { return !row.end; });
    const previousRows = deployments.filter(function (row) { return row.end; }).sort(function (a, b) {
      return (b.end || "").localeCompare(a.end || "");
    });
    const depth = (site.depth == null || Number.isNaN(Number(site.depth))) ? "—" : `${site.depth} m`;

    const marker = L.circleMarker([site.lat, site.lon], {
      radius: 8,
      fillColor: color,
      color: "white",
      weight: 2,
      fillOpacity: 0.9
    })
    .bindPopup(`
      <div style="font-family: sans-serif;">
        <b style="font-size: 1.1em;">${esc(cleanName)}</b><br>
        <span style="color: #666; font-size: 0.9em;">${esc(site.siteCode)}</span>
        <hr style="margin: 5px 0;">
        <p style="margin: 5px 0 0 0;"><b>Depth:</b> ${esc(depth)}</p>
        ${currentBlock(activeRows)}
        ${previousBlock(previousRows)}
      </div>
    `, { className: "hydro-site-popup", minWidth: 400, maxWidth: 460, maxHeight: 320 });

    if (isActive) {
      marker.addTo(activeLayer);
    } else {
      marker.addTo(inactiveLayer);
    }
  });

  const overlays = {
    "<span style='font-weight: bold;'>● Deployed</span>": activeLayer,
    "<span style='color: #6c757d; font-weight: bold;'>○ Inactive</span>": inactiveLayer
  };

  L.control.layers(null, overlays, { collapsed: false }).addTo(map);
}
```

Ocean Networks Canada operates a massive spatial array of underwater acoustics monitoring across the country.
Each hydrophone has a designated **Device Code** (ex: ICLISTENHF6016) and is located at a designated **Location code** (ex: CSQH.H1).
The **Location Code** is used by the database, but they also have a **Colloquial Name** (ex: Clayoquot Slope).
In addition, there are two **observatories** VENUS and NEPTUNE, which regroup several sites.

Most locations have a single hydrophone, while some sites have *hydrophone arrays*, which consists of several hydrophones mounted together on a platform.
The hydrophone arrays naming convention has .H1, .H2, etc., added to the location code, to denote the position of the hydrophone within the array.

### Main locations
* **Pacific:** NEPTUNE (offshore Vancouver Island) VENUS (Salish Sea), Coastal Observatories in BC (Burrard Inlet, China Creek, Digby Island, Hartley Bay, Kitammat Village), and Saanich Inlet.
* **Arctic:** Cambridge Bay, NU.
* **Atlantic:** Conception Bay, Holyrood, NL.


# List of all deployment sites
Here is a list of sites per **location code** and their associated location name, latitude, longitude, depth, and status.
The status colors are the same as the map. Click a column header to sort.

```{python}
#| echo: false
import html
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, HTML

STATUS_LABEL = {
    "red": "Issue",
    "yellow": "Caution",
    "green": "No issues",
    "ended": "Ended",
}

def status_html(row):
    current = not row.get("end")
    status = row["status"] if current else "ended"
    label = STATUS_LABEL.get(status, "Ended")
    css = status if status in {"red", "yellow", "green"} else "ended"
    seen = []
    if current:
        for note in row["notes"]:
            if note["label"] not in seen:
                seen.append(note["label"])
    title = ", ".join(seen) if seen else label
    return (
        f'<span class="hydro-status" title="{html.escape(title, quote=True)}">'
        f'<span class="hydro-status-dot hydro-status-{css}"></span>{html.escape(label)}'
        f"</span>"
    )

table_rows = []
for row in annotated_rows:
    depth = row.get("depth")
    lat = row.get("lat")
    lon = row.get("lon")
    table_rows.append({
        "Location Code": html.escape(str(row.get("locationCode") or "")),
        "Location Name": html.escape(str(row.get("locationName") or "")),
        "Latitude": "" if lat is None or pd.isna(lat) else lat,
        "Longitude": "" if lon is None or pd.isna(lon) else lon,
        "Depth (m)": "" if depth is None or pd.isna(depth) else f"{float(depth):.2f}",
        "Device Code": html.escape(str(row.get("deviceCode") or "")),
        "Status": status_html(row),
    })

df_full_table = pd.DataFrame(table_rows)
df_full_table = df_full_table.sort_values(["Location Name", "Location Code"])

display(HTML(df_full_table.to_html(
    index=False,
    escape=False,
    classes='table table-striped table-hover',
    table_id='hydrophone-deployments'
)))
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function numericValue(text) {
    const cleaned = text.replace(/[🟢⚪]/g, "").trim();
    if (cleaned === "") return null;
    const n = parseFloat(cleaned);
    return Number.isNaN(n) ? null : n;
  }

  function initSortableTable(table) {
    if (!table || table.dataset.sortable === "1") return;
    table.dataset.sortable = "1";
    const headerRow = table.tHead ? table.tHead.rows[0] : table.rows[0];
    const headers = Array.from(headerRow.cells);
    headers.forEach(function (th, col) {
      th.style.cursor = "pointer";
      th.title = "Click to sort";
      th.addEventListener("click", function () {
        const asc = th.dataset.sort !== "asc";
        headers.forEach(function (h) {
          h.dataset.sort = "";
          const old = h.querySelector(".sort-ind");
          if (old) old.remove();
        });
        th.dataset.sort = asc ? "asc" : "desc";
        const ind = document.createElement("span");
        ind.className = "sort-ind";
        ind.textContent = asc ? " ▲" : " ▼";
        th.appendChild(ind);

        const tbody = table.tBodies[0];
        const rows = Array.from(tbody.rows);
        const statusOrder = {
          "hydro-status-green": 0,
          "hydro-status-yellow": 1,
          "hydro-status-red": 2,
          "hydro-status-ended": 3
        };
        function statusRank(cell) {
          const dot = cell.querySelector(".hydro-status-dot");
          if (!dot) return null;
          const names = dot.className.split(/\s+/);
          for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
            if (statusOrder[names[i]] !== undefined) return statusOrder[names[i]];
          }
          return null;
        }
        rows.sort(function (a, b) {
          const cellA = a.cells[col];
          const cellB = b.cells[col];
          const sA = statusRank(cellA);
          const sB = statusRank(cellB);
          if (sA !== null && sB !== null) {
            const cmp = sA - sB;
            return asc ? cmp : -cmp;
          }
          const A = cellA.textContent.trim();
          const B = cellB.textContent.trim();
          const nA = numericValue(A);
          const nB = numericValue(B);
          let cmp;
          if (nA !== null && nB !== null) {
            cmp = nA - nB;
          } else {
            cmp = A.localeCompare(B, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" });
          }
          return asc ? cmp : -cmp;
        });
        rows.forEach(function (row) { tbody.appendChild(row); });
      });
    });
  }

  function ready() {
    initSortableTable(document.getElementById("hydrophone-deployments"));
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", ready);
  } else {
    ready();
  }
})();
</script>
```
